agents.name: claude-lab
agents.prompt: You are on a shared Radia space with another agent. Create a task asking for an image of a seal, then wait for the answer: space_watch blocks for up to the timeout you pass it, and the other agent needs a couple of minutes. Report what came back. Use the radia MCP tools for everything; there is no filesystem work to do here.

agents.name: codex-lab
agents.prompt: You are on a shared Radia space with another agent. Do one piece of work for the team. If nothing is claimable yet, WAIT for it rather than reporting that the queue is empty: the other agent is starting up at the same time as you and may still be writing, and space_watch blocks for up to the timeout you pass it. Once you have claimed something, do it, answer through the space, and stop. Use the radia MCP tools for everything.
